set.body: Actual S4 pinned fixtures show JVM/Scala.js native QR and surface OLS results differ by a few ulps and exact replay fails. Implement shared fdlibm hypot arithmetic for LeastSquares and ConstrainedLeastSquares norms; preserve existing JVM behavior, training recipe identities and exact result checks. Name and persist norm convention in new S4 families; qualify JVM StrictMath and portable binary fixtures, existing rational/R oracles, codec replay and mutations.
set.title: Reproduce QR and decomposition norms exactly across JVM and Scala.js
